resumo: UK charities, protest groups condemn Israeli ban threat after sanctions . Israel had warned UK of 'consequences' for sanctions against UK aid groups . Letter recommends employees and activists barred from entering Israel after UK ban on imports from illegal settlements in West Bank .

titulo: Ed Sheeran tour: Macklemore dropped, other openers quit
resumo: Rapper Macklemore has been dropped from Ed Sheeran's US tour for his onstage support of Palestine . The rapper made pro-Palestinian remarks during shows in New Jersey earlier this month . On Monday, Robert Kraft, the billionaire owner of the New England Patriots, said he would bar him from performing at Gillette Stadium in Massachusetts . All of the British singer's other openers quit the tour to protest the removal .

titulo: Oil rallies for the week as US-Iran fighting resumes; diesel
resumo: Brent crude futures settled at $96.28 a barrel, up 76 cents, or 0.8 per cent . West Texas Intermediate crude futures finished at $91.48 a barrel . For the week, Brent crude rose 7.6 per cent while U.S. crude gained nearly 10 per cent as supply routes in the Middle East remain impaired . A gallon of diesel now costs $5.85 on average in the United States .

titulo: Abdul El-Sayed hits back at Israel questions, suggests his n
resumo: Abdul El-Sayed suggested that reporters press him about the Israel-Hamas war because of his name and his faith . The Michigan Democratic U.S. Senate nominee suggested the media's interest in his stance on the conflict was related to his identity . The candidate doubled down on his assertion that his campaign is focused on Michigan, not the people of Israel .

titulo: Netanyahu's New York UN visit sees unusual Secret Service se
resumo: US Secret Service involved in preparations for Benjamin Netanyahu's visit to UNGA, source says . Netanyahu will land at Newark Airport in New Jersey, closer to Manhattan than JFK Airport in Queens, where the prime minister's plane usually parks . NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani has previously addressed the possibility of Netanyahu traveling to New York for UNGA .
